column1: # Differences between the routes of the formal proofs and the paper's proofs, each with its reason.
# Format: label<TAB>±other<TAB>reason. See Section 7 of each paper's report, papers/<Paper>/REPORT.md. The routes of the papers are in docs/paper_routes.tsv.
# A row with the label `*` records a result used without citation throughout. Each paper has a section below.
# Split from lean4-tob's docs/route_differences.tsv at before-split (6e7bc49): the rows of this repository.

column3: Theorem 4's proof needs more than the fixed-parameter limit of Proposition 5: the estimated parameter and moving tail levels (the gap of E33). `cutTest_null` and `cutTest_alternative` prove what it needs, from the same limit theorems that prove Proposition 5, and the domination of the test distribution by Z².
Proposition 6 is the density of the test distribution, for computing p-values. The proof of Theorem 4 uses only the distribution, which `cutTail` defines directly.

The proof restricts to "generic parameters ensuring that all induced 4-networks with 4-blobs have non-cut CFs", which is Theorem 1 of Allman et al., TINNiK's Theorem 1. `AllmanEtAl2023.cfDetectable_generic` gets it from their Theorem 1 on each induced network.
Through `AllmanEtAl2023.cfDetectable_generic`, which passes `CF`s to the induced networks, as the proof of Allman et al.'s Corollary 1 does.
Through `AllmanEtAl2023.cfDetectable_generic`, which passes generic parameters to the induced networks, as the proof of Allman et al.'s Corollary 1 does.
Through `AllmanEtAl2023.cfDetectable_generic`, which passes B-quartets to the induced networks.
Through `AllmanEtAl2023.closure_sound`: TINNiK's B-quartet Inference is the closure under the rule of Allman et al., and the proof of the rule (`rule_core`) uses that three taxa determine a blob.
Through `AllmanEtAl2023.closure_complete`: the closure reaches every B-quartet by the cycle of Allman et al.'s Lemma 3 (`lemma3_blob`), which uses their Lemma 2 (`determines_of_subnetwork`).

column1: # The definitions, which statements use throughout, those of the later papers included when they reach results of this paper. The routes list a definition only where a statement of the proof needs it by name.

column3: Every statement is on a network of Definition 1 (`IsBinaryNetwork`).
`T_rd(𝒩⁻)` is built on the semidirected network of Definition 5 (`semidirected`, `lsaPlus`), so every statement on it reaches them.
Definition 8 (`IsDeterminedBy`), in the statements on B-quartets, by Definition 12.
Definition 6 (`induced`), in the statements on induced networks.
Definition 11 (`Trd`), in the statements on the reduced tree.
Definition 12 (`IsBlobQuartet`), in the statements on B-quartets.
